Gatekeeper Valentina:
Greetings! I'm Gatekeeper Valentina. I can teleport you somewhere outside of the Ivory Tower. It is a common belief that our Tower is a den of madmen who think only of conquering the world. But there are some people here who are really trying to make the world a better place...
But enough of that. Where do you want to go?
(You can teleport for free if your main class is Lv. 104 or lower.)
